title: How a Trading Problem Led Me to Build My First iOS App
author: valeriibaidak
selftext:
I recently released my first iOS app: **VeliAlert**.  
The idea didn’t come from looking for a new side project. It came from solving a real problem.  
I was building an AI agent for trading. It continuously monitored the market, analyzed conditions, and was supposed to notify me whenever an important trading signal appeared.  
The problem was that the most interesting opportunities often happened at night.  
The AI could send notifications, but a regular push notification wasn’t enough—it was too easy to miss while sleeping.  
That made me think: why shouldn’t an AI agent be able to wake me up when something actually matters?  
That’s how **VeliAlert** was born.  
After installing the app, you simply generate an MCP link. From that point, any MCP-compatible AI agent can:  
🔔 Set alarms  
📲 Send push notifications  
🚨 Trigger SOS notifications  
Later, I realized this wasn’t just useful for trading.  
For example:  
Claude Code finishes a long code generation or refactoring task.  
An AI agent completes an automation and needs your attention.  
An AI assistant creates one-time alarms based on your schedule or calendar.  
From idea to App Store release, the project took about one month.  
The app includes a **7-day free trial** if you’d like to try it yourself.
